profile.founded: Suven Pharmaceuticals: CDMO demerged from Suven Life Sciences and listed 2020 (Jasti family); Cohance Lifesciences: API, formulations and CDMO platform assembled by Advent from acquisitions (incl. RA Chem Pharma, Avra Laboratories, Inventis Drug Delivery Systems; AR FY26 note 60)
profile.owner: Advent International (Berhyanda Ltd 33.34%, Jusmiral Holdings Ltd 24.15%; 57.49% at Jun-2026)
profile.segments: Pharma CDMO (small molecules, ADC payloads/linkers, NJ Bio bioconjugation, Sapala oligonucleotide building blocks), API+ (niche APIs, pellets and formulations), Specialty Chemicals (agrochemical CDMO, performance materials: photochromic, OLED)
profile.customers: Top 20 global innovators account for >85% of small-molecule CDMO revenue; ~two-thirds of API revenue from innovators and large generic companies; 18 commercial molecules and 10 Phase III molecules in CDMO
profile.employees: 2,811 permanent employees in the company (standalone) at Mar-2026; 400+ R&D scientists
profile.plants: ~3,000+ kL of pilot and commercial capacity: CDMO at Suryapet, Pashamylaram, Vizag (ADC/high potency), Nacharam (oligo); API at Atchutapuram, Jaggaiahpet, Ankleshwar, Jadcherla, Patancheru; specialty chemicals at Genome Valley and Vizag; formulations at Nacharam; NJ Bio at Princeton, New Jersey
profile.src: q1ppt p.21, 33; q4call; ar26 p.40, Board's report

guidance.fy27: Q1 the low point; sequential improvement in Q2; year-on-year comparability by end-H1 and growth in H2; EBITDA margin for FY27 'closer to previous year margin percentage' (FY26 adjusted 21.0%), accelerating from FY28 (CFO, q1call)
guidance.fy28: API+ and Specialty Chemicals: double-digit growth from FY28 (q1call; FY27 a 'year of qualification' in agrochemicals)
guidance.longTerm: US$1 bn revenue with mid-30s EBITDA margin by FY30 reaffirmed in Nov-2025 (q2ppt); now 'an aspiration... we may be a little bit away from it over the next 3 to 4 years', update promised by Dec-2026 (Umang Vohra, q1call)
guidance.capex: ~₹300 cr in FY27 (q4call); ₹59.8 cr in Q1FY27
history: FY26 revenue cut to roughly flat (from growth), adjusted EBITDA margin to high-20s (from early-30s); US$1 bn FY30 kept
FY26 revenue cut again to an early-to-mid double-digit decline
FY27 growth year weighted to H2; Q1 the low point; FY26 delivered -13% revenue, 21% adjusted margin
Q1 2.2% adjusted margin as guided; FY27 margin near FY26; US$1 bn now an aspiration
guidance.src: q2ppt; q3ppt p.6; q4ppt p.6; q1ppt p.5; q1call

cdmo.destocking: Two large commercial molecules destocked in FY26 (~₹260 cr revenue impact); restocking order received for one, deliveries in Q4FY27 and FY28 (spread over two years); the other still in discussion
cdmo.newCommercial: Two molecules moved into commercial supply (six intermediates, deliveries Q2-Q3FY27); two more expected in 12-15 months, one already US FDA approved
cdmo.patentExpiry: Two commercial molecules face patent expiry; decline already seen in FY25-26 (q1call)
cdmo.commercialShare: commercial 57% / development 43% of standalone CDMO in Q1FY27 (over 70% in FY26)

adc.njBio: 56% of NJ Bio Inc (Princeton, NJ; ADC/XDC CRDMO) bought 20-Dec-2024 for ₹547.96 cr; goodwill ₹419 cr; FY26 revenue ₹188 cr, loss ₹65.7 cr; Q1FY27 revenue ₹35 cr, adjusted EBITDA -₹32.8 cr; 44% minority holders have a put option (liability recognised)
adc.payloads: India payload/linker business (Vizag): two unique commercial ADC payload supplies to large innovators, three payload DMFs filed in FY26, MMAE and exatecan added; customised payload order for Q2FY27
adc.ajicap: AJICAP site-specific conjugation collaboration with Ajinomoto (q4ppt)

oligo.sapala: 67.5% of Sapala Organics (Hyderabad; oligonucleotide building blocks, amidites, tc-DNA) bought 11-Jul-2024 for ₹258 cr; FY26 revenue ₹49.7 cr (loss ₹0.6 cr); Q1FY27 revenue ₹27.4 cr (2.5x) at a strong margin; new amidites facility at Nacharam complete; path to full ownership by FY30 agreed with founder Dr P.Y. Reddy, who leads the combined nucleic-acid business

timeline: Suven Pharmaceuticals demerged from Suven Life Sciences and listed (Jasti family 60%)
Advent assembles Cohance from acquisitions (incl. RA Chem Pharma, Avra Laboratories, Inventis)
Advent buys 50.1% of Suven from the Jasti family (~₹6,313 cr agreed)
Board approves the Cohance merger (11 Suven shares for 295 Cohance shares)
Cohance buys 67.5% of Sapala Organics for ₹258 cr
Suven buys 56% of NJ Bio for ₹548 cr
Merger effective; 12.80 cr new shares; renamed Cohance Lifesciences
Advent's Jusmiral sells 8.92% at ~₹906 (₹3,094 cr), 210-day lock-up
MD Dr V Prasada Raju steps down
FY26 guidance cut; stock -27% in 11 sessions
Nacharam Warning Letter; FY26 guidance cut again; CEO Dr Sudhir Kumar Singh leaves (4-Feb-2026)
Umang Vohra (ex-Cipla MD & Global CEO) named Executive Chairman (1-May) and Group CEO (20-May); Vivek Sharma steps down
Promoters refinance holdco debt: 54.36% of shares pledged for a US$285 mn term loan
Q1FY27: loss, 2.2% adjusted margin; Pashamylaram Form 483 (five observations)
